cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned Grandma's chair like yours. Head places settled. Does eldest or birthday child get the head seat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I turned mine out of the sun. Put two chairs there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shade first. Which tradition decides who gets served first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Serve them together. Except there's only one birthday pudding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose before I bring it in: elders first or birthdays first? I can divide it once somebody's had the wish.

reason: A mistakes a shade adjustment for seating custom and maintains apparent procedural fluency while asking B to choose. Preserve inclusive solutions until B's one pudding makes ordering necessary.
